notes.zh-CN: 手机端打开「电脑会话」时直接停在最新一条消息，长对话不再需要手动滑到最底部；切换会话和电脑端流式输出新内容时都会自动跟随到底部，只有当你向上翻看历史时才保持当前位置。macOS 为通用包；Windows 为未签名安装包；APK 调试签名，IPA 开发签名（仅限团队已注册设备）。
notes.en: Opening a mirrored conversation on the phone now lands on the newest message, so long transcripts no longer need a manual scroll to the bottom; switching sessions and streaming updates follow the tail automatically, and the position is kept only while you are reading back through history. macOS ships universal; Windows installers are unsigned; the APK is debug-signed and the IPA is development-signed.
